thesis_core.name: mispr_fin_disc
thesis_core.rationale: Stambaugh-Yuan mispricing (mgmt+performance) says overpriced/overinvesting firms earn low returns; combined with q-theory (low net equity issuance & low asset growth = disciplined capital). Long cheap/disciplined, short overpriced/overissuing.

thesis_core.name: mispricing_combo
thesis_core.rationale: Composite of two mispricing scores aggregating 11 anomalies; captures systematic investor over/under-reaction not explained by risk.

thesis_core.name: fin_inv_discipline
thesis_core.rationale: q-theory / investment-CAPM: firms that issue equity and grow assets aggressively subsequently underperform (overinvestment, market timing).

thesis_core.name: qual_val_mom
thesis_core.rationale: Three independent premia: gross profitability (Novy-Marx quality), book-to-market (value risk/mispricing), 12-1 momentum (underreaction). Diversified across rationales.

thesis_core.name: prof_trend_ts
thesis_core.rationale: Hypothesis: improving profitability trend signals future returns. Included as a weak control to contrast against economically-grounded factors.

thesis_extended.name: mispr_fin_quality
thesis_extended.rationale: Mispricing should reverse more strongly when firms also avoid external equity issuance, restrain asset growth, and show real profitability support.

thesis_extended.name: financing_reversal_guard
thesis_extended.rationale: Low net financing plus intermediate momentum, guarded against short-term reversal, captures disciplined capital structure and underreaction.

thesis_extended.name: mispr_lowrisk_disc
thesis_extended.rationale: Mispricing may be more investable when not concentrated in high idiosyncratic-risk names and when issuance is disciplined.

thesis_extended.name: cheap_prof_lowissue
thesis_extended.rationale: Cheap profitable firms with low equity issuance should combine value, quality, and disciplined financing premia.

thesis_extended.name: value_mom_stability
thesis_extended.rationale: Value and momentum signals should be more persistent when realized and idiosyncratic volatility are low.

thesis_extended.name: quality_trend_value
thesis_extended.rationale: Improving profitability combined with cheap valuation and restrained investment may identify underreacted quality recovery.

thesis_extended.name: liquid_mispricing
thesis_extended.rationale: Mispricing may be cleaner when liquidity is better and trading frictions are lower, improving implementation credibility.

thesis_extended.name: safe_value_prof
thesis_extended.rationale: Value and profitability should be more robust among safer, lower-beta firms rather than distressed cheap stocks.

thesis_extended.name: mispricing_trend_discipline
thesis_extended.rationale: Persistent mispricing signals combined with persistent low issuance and low asset growth should identify durable anomaly exposure.

thesis_extended.name: issuance_trend_reversal
thesis_extended.rationale: Persistent low external financing combined with momentum and short-term reversal control captures capital discipline plus delayed price adjustment.

thesis_extended.name: investment_quality_ratio
thesis_extended.rationale: Profitability per unit of asset growth favors efficient firms; low issuance and value add capital discipline and valuation support.

thesis_extended.name: risk_adjusted_fin_disc
thesis_extended.rationale: Risk-adjusted momentum combined with low issuance and low idiosyncratic volatility should isolate cleaner underreaction.

thesis_extended.name: mispr_profit_interaction
thesis_extended.rationale: Mispricing-management signals should matter more when supported by unusually strong profitability; financing and investment discipline reduce overvaluation risk.

thesis_extended.name: value_profit_ratio_stable
thesis_extended.rationale: Value times profitability scaled by realized volatility favors cheap profitable firms whose signal is not simply high-risk compensation.

thesis_extended.name: profitability_acceleration_value
thesis_extended.rationale: A profitability improvement is more valuable when the firm is cheap and not aggressively expanding assets.
